objective: One C1 nonstream vs stream comparison on the current source, after one warmup per mode.
source: Same current candidate snapshot for both arms; stream=false versus stream=true. This is a mode comparison, not a comparison of old and new scheduler versions.
reference: Pinned checkpoint assets/HT_ref_audio.wav, SHA256 recorded by CPU preflight; same default voice for the sample and both arms.
endpoint: /v1/audio/speech over localhost; PCM16 mono 24kHz; stream mode uses SSE to identify generated chunks.
schedule: Single server; sequential warmup/nonstream, warmup/stream, measured/nonstream, measured/stream. No repetitions, C2 or ABBA.
primary_metric: Meaningful-audio arrival time: first received10ms PCM window with RMS>=0.001 fullscale.
secondary_metrics: simulated playback stall count/time with100ms buffer reserve
output_work: Experiment-only adapter writes full codec count, SHA256 and token IDs from existing CPU tensor once per request, shared in both modes.
validity: Stop on first failure; no retries or extra requests.
Exact measured input and codec hashes must match; otherwise no matched-work speedup claim.
Meaningful audio must exist; streamed audio has at least2 deltas.
exclusions: No claimed GPU overlap without GPU traces
No ASR/MOS or speaker similarity evaluation
No cancel/fault injection during measured timing cohorts
limitations: Only one timed request per mode; no variability estimate.
SSE serialization is part of the stream path.
